about.title: About
about.quote: I love this world, I wish to keep programming my whole life as I have done until now, with the utmost enthusiasm and dedication.
paragraphs: I remember the first day of school when I had signed up for something called "programming". I was as curious as I was scared since I knew nothing about the subject, I only knew I was good at "computer stuff". Today that fear has become confidence and my greatest virtue.

I started with Java developing on Android and although I liked it, I decided to take a web course. That is when I saw the potential that web development offers: its simplicity and flexibility. I realized that most projects could be done with that technology and I found it exciting - I had found the branch I loved!

I have worked as a back-end and front-end developer, with the latter being my favorite as it is closer to the user. I have a passion for how things work, a certain obsession with user experience, and I find satisfaction in seeing the final result.
That is all from me. I would like to continue growing personally and professionally in a great company. If you are as enthusiastic as I am about this world, do not hesitate to contact me!
